latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Convert static product images into animated 1080p video clips in ChatGPT.

- Upload up to three JPG images and describe the video result you want.
- Fully cloud-based rendering—no installation required; outputs ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos within 30–60 seconds.
- Simple token-based authentication with optional free trial; setup handled automatically on first use.
- Supports editing actions, exporting, credit checking, and session state via clear, intent-based commands.
- Error handling for common issues like expired tokens, file limits, or export restrictions, with clear guidance for users.
- Accepts popular image and video formats (JPG, PNG, GIF, MP4, etc.); max file size 200MB.
